iNaturalist 等公民科学 App 的数据如何被科研使用？

How do citizen-science apps like iNaturalist feed into research?

用户上传带定位和时间的现象照片，经社区与专家鉴定后汇入公开数据库，可用来绘制物种分布、追踪入侵种扩散、评估保护成效，甚至辅助新种发现。
Users post geotagged, time-stamped photos; community and expert IDs feed public databases used to map distributions, track invasions, gauge conservation and even flag new species.

为什么有些湖在秋天会“翻库（turnover）”把底部养分翻上来？

Why do some lakes 'turn over' in autumn, bringing bottom nutrients up?

夏末表层热水、底层冷水分层；秋凉后上下温度接近、风一吹整湖混合，底部富含营养的冷水翻到表层，喂饱藻类与鱼，却也可能引发短暂水华。
In late summer warm surface and cold bottom are layered; autumn cooling makes temperatures similar and wind mixes the whole lake, bringing nutrient-rich deep water up to feed algae and fish—though it can trigger a brief bloom.

观鸟的入门三件套是什么，为什么“记录”比“拍到”更重要？

What's the beginner trio for birdwatching, and why is 'recording' more important than 'photographing'?

一副望远镜、一本图鉴、一个笔记本就够了。记下时间地点和行为，长期积累就成了本地鸟类日历，既能帮自己也能帮科研，比只求一张清晰照片更有价值。
Binoculars, a field guide and a notebook are enough. Logging time, place and behavior builds a local bird calendar that helps both you and science—more valuable than just one sharp photo.

候鸟为什么偏爱沿着“迁徙通道”飞，而不是乱飞？

Why do migratory birds prefer following 'flyways' rather than wandering?

迁徙通道是代代相传的“空中高速路”，沿线和风、食物水源和落脚歇脚点连成线，最省力也最安全；破坏其中一段湿地，整条路线都会断点。
Flyways are inherited 'air highways' lining up tailwinds, food, water and rest stops—least effort and safest; damaging one wetland segment breaks the whole route.

萤火虫为什么会一闪一闪地发光？

Why do fireflies blink on and off?

它们肚子里的光是求偶的“信号灯”：雄虫闪出特定节奏，雌虫用同样的闪法回答。越多黑暗、越少灯光的地方，越容易看到这场夏夜的“灯语”。
The light in their belly is a mating signal: males flash a pattern and females answer with the same blink. The darker and less lit the place, the easier to see this summer-night 'light language'.

为什么海边退潮后会留下很多小螃蟹和小贝壳？

Why are there many tiny crabs and shells left after the tide goes out?

退潮把海水暂时退走，原本藏在浅水里的螃蟹、贝壳和海星就露在了湿沙上；这是去海边“赶海”看小生命的好时候，但记得轻轻放下、别带走它们。
The retreating tide temporarily leaves behind crabs, shells and starfish that hid in shallow water, exposed on wet sand—a great time for a gentle 'tide-pool' look, but put them back softly and don't take them.

为什么秋天树叶会变黄变红（和环境信号的关系）？

Why do leaves turn yellow and red in autumn (and the environmental signal)?

日照变短、气温下降，树停止制造叶绿素，原本被盖住的黄橙色显现；一些树还会合成红色花青素护叶、回收养分，是植物对季节变化的“主动告别”。
Shorter days and cooler air stop chlorophyll making, revealing hidden yellow-orange; some trees also make red anthocyanins to protect leaves while reclaiming nutrients—a plant's active farewell to the season.

窗台上的小花为什么要把脑袋转向窗户?

Why does my windowsill flower turn its head toward the window?

植物和我们一样要吃饭,它们的饭是阳光!叶子会用阳光做营养。哪边亮,它就把叶子伸向哪边,像小朋友朝着香喷喷的饭菜转头一样,这叫向光性。
Plants eat too — sunlight turns into their food inside their leaves! Wherever light comes from, they stretch their leaves toward it, just like you turning toward yummy dinner. It is called phototropism.
